recommendations.Aphids Infestation: Spray neem oil or insecticidal soap on undersides of leaves.
recommendations.Caterpillar Damage: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) spray or handpick caterpillars.
recommendations.Leafhopper Infestation: Use insecticidal soap or yellow sticky cards; remove weeds.
recommendations.Whiteflies Infestation: Apply neem oil or insecticidal soap; place yellow sticky traps.
